title: The Invoices import template has the headers *Line Title and Line Description
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use Google Sheets (File, then Import, then Upload) to open downloaded files, so accented letters and character counts read correctly.
  • Start on Settings, then Invoices under Data Import in the Settings left menu.
custom_steps:
1. Click Download template.
  2. Open the downloaded template in Google Sheets.
  3. Search the header row for "What are you doing".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A template file downloads.

Step 2:

  • Right after *Item the header row has "*Line Title" and then "Line Description" (columns 16 and 17, P and Q), followed by Tech Story.

Step 3:

  • "What are you doing" is not found in the header row, and neither is "Why are you doing it"; "*Line Title" is still there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10133 (Story 4, The Imports)

  • S4-R2: “The historical invoice import's two columns (Administration → Invoices) are named "*Line Title" and "Line Description", replacing "*Line Title - What are you doing" and "Line Description - Why are you doing it".”
  • S4-R6: “The downloadable sample file and the on-screen column list both show the new names.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-11257, and bug SV-11850 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10133, Nemanja Djuric, 8 Oct 2026 (Ready for QA testing): “Download template: the header has "*Line Title,Line Description"; every other column and the order are unchanged.”
